purpose: Define the minimum evidence required before a Phi job may claim deployed/runtime verification.

source.note: Source inspection alone cannot satisfy runtime acceptance checks.

deployment.note: A successful build/deploy proves delivery, not UI behavior.

rules: Runtime acceptance criteria require browser, API, media, or persistence evidence appropriate to the criterion.
No agent may translate missing evidence into passed evidence.
Source verified and deployment verified are distinct from runtime verified.
If the connected environment cannot exercise the required runtime, return needs_work with missing evidence named.
Independent verifier records evidence after the writer and may not alter source or deployment.
Android-specific bugs require an Android/mobile profile when browser tooling supports it; otherwise record the profile limitation.
